title: [RFC] Replace Gather-based Weight Transfer with P2P for Faster Sync and Balanced GPU Memory
body: ## Summary This RFC proposes introducing **shard-level P2P weight transfer** in VIME to replace the current `all_gather` + broadcast weight sync path. The primary goals are: 1. **Balanced GPU memory** — reduce infer TP imbalance from ~10 GiB to **<200 MiB**; reduce trainer rank-0 skew from ~10 GiB to **~6.3 GiB** after sync 2. **Faster weight transfer** — prototype pure-NCCL tests show **0.5–0.8s** vs main broadcast **~5.2s** (non-offload); in real VIME training (non-colocate offload), Timer `update_weights` averages **~20.3s** (48 steps on A100), with persistent NCCL groups The solution is rolled out in two phases: - **Phase 1** (implemented and validated): shard P2P when `train_tp == infer_tp` - **Phase 2** (planned, not yet implemented): full-mesh P2P for arbitrary TP configurations, following the design of [asystem-awex](https://github.com/inclusionAI/asystem-awex) > As a side effect, this also mitigates trainer GPU memory skew reported in [#4](https://github.com/vllm-project/vime/issues/4) (NcclBridge ~10 GiB extra on rank 0). --- ## Motivation ### Current Approach (Main Branch — Gather + Broadcast) The current path has two main bottlenecks: | Problem | Impact | |---------|--------| | TP0 must `all_gather` + broadcast full weights | ~5.2s transfer time per step (Qwen3-4B, non-offload) | | Rank 0 holds NCCL broadcast buffer + NcclBridge subprocess | ~10 GiB extra memory on trainer GPU 0 | | Each rollout engine receives full weights, vLLM splits internally | ~10 GiB infer TP memory imbalance | | Other trainer TP ranks idle during sync | Wasted parallelism; uneven memory footprint | Compared with the SGLang backend (which uses in-process distributed groups instead of NcclBridge), all trainer ranks report similar memory (~1 GiB gap). This confirms that **gather + rank-0 broadcast is the root cause of both slow transfer and memory skew** in vLLM native sync. --- ## Proposed Solution ### Overall Architecture --- ## Phase 1: Shard-level P2P (train_tp == infer_tp) — Implemented ### Core Idea 1. **Converts only its own shard** (`convert_to_hf_shard`, no `all_gather` needed) 2. **P2P sends directly** to the matching inference TP rank via a dedicated NCCL group ### Transfer Flow (Two Phases) | Phase | Parameter Type | Method | |-------|---------------|--------| | Phase A | embedding / output_layer | all_gather → convert_to_hf → broadcast (special vocab padding handling) | | Phase B | all other layers | convert_to_hf_shard → P2P to matching infer TP rank | ### Activation Condition ```python train_tp == infer_tp # i.e. --tensor-model-parallel-size == --rollout-num-gpus-per-engine ``` Falls back to Phase 0 (original broadcast) when condition is not met. ### Key Code Changes | File | Changes | |------|---------| | `vime/backends/megatron_utils/update_weight/update_weight_from_distributed.py` | Add `_use_shard_conversion()`, `_sync_weights_shard_packed()`, `update_weights_from_distributed_p2p()`; modify `connect_rollout_engines` (shard groups + lock) | | `vime/backends/vllm_utils/vllm_engine.py` | Add `target_tp_rank` parameter to `init_weights_update_group` | | `vime/backends/megatron_utils/megatron_to_hf/` | Add `convert_to_hf_shard()`, output vLLM combined names `qkv_proj` / `gate_up_proj` | | `docker/patch/latest/vllm.patch` | `nccl_engine.py` supports `target_tp_rank` + multi-group; `gpu_worker.py` fixes `param.data.copy_()` | **Design principle:** All changes add new code paths only; original broadcast logic is untouched. Non-P2P paths are completely unaffected. ### Phase 1 Validation Results (Qwen3-4B, TP=2, 4 train + 4 rollout) **Test environment:** A800-server, container `vime_new`, branch `p2p-weight-transfer`, job `raysubmit_jU3nuLJSRXHE9LA3`. Additional 48-step run on A100-server (non-colocate offload). > **Measurement note:** The **0.5–0.8s** figure is from a **prototype pure-NCCL test** (`p2p_test_v2.py`) that measures only NCCL send/recv — it excludes Megatron→HF format conversion, vLLM engine interaction, and offload sleep/wake. **Real VIME training** numbers use Timer `update_weights` (connect → send weights → disconnect, excluding sleep/wake). | Metric | Main (broadcast) | Phase 1 (Shard P2P) | Notes | |--------|-----------------|---------------------|-------| | `update_weights_time` (non-offload) | ~5.2s | — | Main branch baseline | | Pure NCCL transfer (prototype) | — | **0.5–0.8s** | Isolated NCCL only; steps 0–3: 0.96 / 0.53 / 0.84 / 0.60s | | Timer `update_weights` (offload, real training) | — | **~19–21s** (A800) | Includes convert + engine interaction | | Timer `update_weights` (offload, 48 steps, A100) | — | **mean 20.3s**, median 20.2s | std 1.6s; min 13.8s (step 2); max 23.3s | | Infer TP memory imbalance | ~10 GiB | **<200 MiB** | e.g. Engine0: 62185 vs 61993 MiB (192 MiB gap) | | Trainer memory imbalance (after sync) | ~10 GiB | **~6.3 GiB** | Rank0 22.99 GB vs Rank1 16.71 GB | | `train_rollout_logprob_abs_diff` | ~0.012 | ~0.012 | Steps 0–2: 0.01213 / 0.01290 / 0.01214 | | Training throughput (tok/s) | ~16334 | ~16334 | actor_train_tok_per_s at step 1 | | First P2P version (offload, pre-optimization) | — | ~17–18s | Reference only | > Log verification: P2P active → `"Using shard P2P weight sync (TP rank X/Y)"`; fallback → `"Using vLLM packed weight sync (bucketed...)"`. ### Phase 1 Benefits | Goal | Phase 1 Effect | |------|---------------| | Infer memory balance | TP imbalance reduced from ~10 GiB to **<200 MiB** | | Trainer memory balance | Rank-0 skew reduced from ~10 GiB to **~6.3 GiB** after sync (rank 0 still holds some NCCL buffers) | | Transfer speed (pure NCCL prototype) | **0.5–0.8s** vs main **~5.2s** (~8× in isolated NCCL test, not end-to-end training) | | Transfer speed (real training, offload) | Timer `update_weights` **~19–21s**; persistent NCCL groups avoid per-step group rebuild (step 2 hit 13.8s on first reuse) | | Training correctness | No regression in `train_rollout_logprob_abs_diff` (~0.012) | **Phase 1 limitation:** Only supports `train_tp == infer_tp`; falls back to broadcast on TP mismatch, so speed and memory benefits do not apply in that configuration. --- ## Phase 2: Full-mesh P2P (Arbitrary TP) — Planned > **Status: not yet implemented in VIME.** No VIME test results are available for Phase 2. The detailed design below follows [asystem-awex](https://github.com/inclusionAI/asystem-awex), which already supports cross-TP weight exchange with P2P transfer plans and has published benchmark data. ### Why Phase 2 Is Needed Phase 1 only works when `train_tp == infer_tp`. Common RL deployments often use mismatched TP (e.g. train TP=2, infer TP=4 for larger rollout throughput). In those cases VIME still falls back to gather + broadcast, losing both the speed and memory balance benefits. ### Reference: asystem-awex Architecture Awex is a dedicated weight synchronization framework with three main components: | Component | Role | |-----------|------| | **WeightWriter** | Runs in each training worker; collects shard metadata, converts weights, builds reshard transfer plan, sends weights | | **WeightReader** | Runs on each inference instance; collects shard metadata, converts weights, receives weights in-place on GPU | | **MetaServer** | Job-level service for discovery, global weight metadata exchange, and event notification | Core pipeline (from [awex docs](https://github.com/inclusionAI/asystem-awex)): 1. **Unified train/infer weight convert** — normalize different parallelism strategies and tensor layouts into a unified format 2. **Global weight metadata exchange** — each worker reports shard metadata; MetaServer aggregates globally 3. **P2P transmission execution plan** — deterministic peer-to-peer send/recv plan built from global metadata (supports arbitrary TP mapping) 4. **NCCL (or RDMA) P2P transfer** — execute plan via NCCL send/recv; only necessary shards transferred, in-place update on inference side Awex published benchmarks (for reference, not VIME results): | Model Scale | Weight Size | verl Time | Awex NCCL | Awex RDMA | |-------------|------------|-----------|-----------|-----------| | 10B | 31 GB | 3.5s | 0.8s | 0.5s | | 100B | 191 GB | 35s | 9s | 3.2s | | 1000B | 1000 GB (FP8) | — | 20s | 6s | ### Proposed VIME Phase 2 Design (following awex) When `train_tp != infer_tp` (constraint: `max_tp % min_tp == 0`): 1. Each training TP rank **all_gather → convert to vLLM internal format** (combined `qkv_proj` / `gate_up_proj`) 2. **Reshard split** by inference TP layout (QKV / gate_up / o_proj / down_proj handled separately) 3. Create a **1:1 NCCL group** (world_size=2) for each `(train_tp_rank, infer_tp_rank)` pair 4. Execute P2P transfer per the deterministic plan (no rank-0 full broadcast) Example: train TP=2, infer TP=4 ``` Train rank 0 --group(0,0)--> Infer rank 0 --group(0,1)--> Infer rank 1 Train rank 1 --group(1,2)--> Infer rank 2 --group(1,3)--> Infer rank 3 ``` ### Key Technical Points (planned) | Technique | Description | awex Reference | |-----------|-------------|----------------| | Unified weight convert | Normalize Megatron/vLLM tensor layouts before reshard | `awex/engine/mcore`, weight convert layer | | Reshard split | Split full weights by infer TP; QKV by head, o_proj/down_proj on dim=1 | P2P transmission execution plan | | Two-phase sync | Separate all_gather/convert from NCCL send to avoid deadlock | WeightWriter pipeline | | 1:1 NCCL groups | Independent group per `(train, infer)` pair, full-mesh topology | NCCL send/recv in awex | | `target_tp_rank` + multi-group | vLLM workers selectively join corresponding groups | vLLM plugin in awex | ### Planned Code Changes (Phase 2 vs Phase 1) | File | Planned Changes | |------|----------------| | `update_weight_from_distributed.py` | Add `_use_reshard_conversion()`, `_sync_weights_reshard()`, `connect_rollout_engines_reshard()`, `update_weights_reshard_packed()` | | `megatron_to_hf/qwen2.py` | Add `convert_qwen2_to_hf_vllm()` for vLLM-format output | | vLLM `nccl_engine.py` | Extend multi-group dict + `shard_rank` support | ### Phase 2 Open Work (no results yet) - [ ] Implement cross-TP reshard path (train TP=2, infer TP=4 as first target) - [ ] Validate training correctness (`train_rollout_logprob_abs_diff`) - [ ] Benchmark `update_weights_time` vs broadcast baseline - [ ] Extend to MoE models (e.g. Qwen3-30B-A3B, train TP=2, infer TP=6) - [ ] NPU (HCCL) adaptation on ascend branch - [ ] Consider deeper integration with awex library vs inline VIME implementation --- ## Comparison: Three Modes | Dimension | Broadcast (today) | Phase 1: Shard P2P | Phase 2: Full-mesh P2P | |-----------|-------------------|--------------------|-----------------------| | Status | main branch | **validated** | **planned** | | Applicability | Any TP config | `train_tp == infer_tp` | `max_tp % min_tp == 0` | | Trainer rank imbalance (after sync) | ~10 GiB | **~6.3 GiB** | Expected: balanced | | `update_weights_time` (Qwen3-4B) | ~5.2s (non-offload) | prototype **0.5–0.8s**; real training **~20s** (offload) | TBD (awex ref: sub-second for 10B) | | Infer TP imbalance | ~10 GiB | **<200 MiB** | Expected: <200 MiB | | Training correctness | baseline | no regression (~0.012) | TBD | | Reference | — | `p2p_weight_transfer_test_report.md` | [asystem-awex](https://github.com/inclusionAI/asystem-awex) | --- ## Proposed Rollout Plan ### Step 1: Merge Phase 1 (low risk, high reward) - [ ] Submit PR: `feature/p2p_transfer` → main - [ ] Include vLLM patch (`docker/patch/latest/vllm.patch`) - [ ] Default behavior unchanged (auto-fallback to broadcast on TP mismatch) - [ ] Auto-enable shard P2P when TP matches (no new flag required, or optional `--vllm-weight-sync-mode p2p`) - [ ] CI: Qwen3-4B TP=2 matched scenario smoke test - [ ] Docs: weight sync mode guide + troubleshooting **Expected benefit:** Significantly improved infer-side GPU memory balance (<200 MiB TP imbalance); reduced trainer rank-0 skew (~6.3 GiB vs ~10 GiB). Pure NCCL prototype demonstrates ~8× NCCL transfer improvement; end-to-end training `update_weights` is dominated by convert/engine/offload overhead (~20s). ### Step 2: Implement and validate Phase 2 (medium risk, extends TP flexibility) - [ ] Implement cross-TP reshard P2P following [asystem-awex](https://github.com/inclusionAI/asystem-awex) design - [ ] First target: Qwen3-4B, train TP=2, infer TP=4 - [ ] Validate training correctness and benchmark vs broadcast - [ ] Extend MoE model support (Qwen3-30B-A3B, train TP=2, infer TP=6) - [ ] NPU (HCCL) adaptation on ascend branch - [ ] Evaluate: inline implementation vs integrating awex as a dependency ### Step 3: Deprecate Broadcast Path (optional, long-term) - [ ] Once all TP configs use P2P, deprecate broadcast path - [ ] Remove NcclBridge rank-0 subprocess dependency --- ## Open Questions 1. **API design:** Add `--vllm-weight-sync-mode {native, p2p, auto}`? Or auto-enable P2P when TP matches? 2. **vLLM patch upstreaming:** Should `target_tp_rank` / multi-group support be submitted to vLLM upstream instead of docker patch only? 3. **Embedding layer:** Phase 1 still uses all_gather + broadcast for embedding — is there a better approach? 4. **Phase 2 implementation strategy:** Inline VIME code following awex design, or integrate `awex` library directly? 5. **NPU adaptation:** ascend branch already has HCCL engine patch — how to integrate Phase 1/2 P2P with HCCL? (awex has experimental NPU support via HCCL) 6. **MoE models:** What are the boundaries of Phase 2 cross-TP reshard support for expert parallel? --- ## References - [asystem-awex](https://github.com/inclusionAI/asystem-awex) — Reference architecture for Phase 2 full-mesh P2P and cross-TP reshard - Internal validation docs (Phase 1 only): - `p2p_weight_transfer_guide.md` — Phase 1 engineering guide - `shard_p2p_principle.md` — Architecture diagrams - `p2p_weight_transfer_test_report.md` — A800/A100 test report - Related: [#4 — NcclBridge pins ~10GiB extra memory on trainer GPU 0](https://github.com/vllm-project/vime/issues/4) (memory skew partially addressed by Phase 1) - Best practices from skyrl, prime rl, and veRL (see comment on #4)
